notes: Sheet 4 (Lincoln Park / outer Richmond), June 1990 edition. Single heavy frame rule (~10 px) on the left, top and right; The bottom edge sits just above the thick top bar of the ruled-off legend and title strip (README rule 3: the strip is outside, with the district key, the planning-code note, the north arrow, the scale bar and the sheet number printed in it, so there is no remove polygon). Each side's inner edge was measured line by line from the scan (the longest dark run across the rule, its inner end), smoothed with a robust local-linear fit (+-300 px, residuals over 2.5 px dropped, so map ink running into a rule and 1 px nubs do not pull it), and the outline set 2 px inside the fit's 95th-percentile inner edge (README rule 1: the 1-bit rules are stair-stepped with 1 px nubs), points every ~200 px; corners where the fitted sides meet, then moved 2 px further in on both axes to clear the small rounded fillets inside the frame's corners. Measured paper between outline and rule: median 2-3 px, at most 5 px anywhere (README rule 8). The page is turned slightly (left and right rules drift ~20-28 px right from top to bottom; the legend bar's top edge rises ~36 px (y decreasing) from left to right); each side follows its own rule. No compass rose, legend block or SECTION badge inside the frame, so no remove polygon. PACIFIC OCEAN, LINCOLN PARK, FORT MILEY, SUTRO HEIGHTS, PRESIDIO, OUTER CLEMENT NCD and the district codes are map. No map ink touches the frame. Ink under the outline: none (the corner inset cleared the fillets at the top-left and top-right corners, which an outline at the fitted corners grazed).
